title: Construct complete P104 forward word and conditional hosting invoice
body:
Completes the actual query construction and all eight P104 correction terms in one finite forward word. The certificate uses 31 ordinary dirty fanout helpers and eight sequential rank-seven private copies. Exact replay checks all 735 public input columns, dirty restoration, common scalar charts, and public/private frame chronology. A second certificate changes 339 scalar charts while preserving coefficients, operation order, and every boundary frame, reducing the native invoice.

The package also checks literal native operators and a concrete inherited-window packing of 75,888 helper roles across 144 calls, using the actual lifetime widths rather than the old helper widths. The coalesced word's ideal-packing gain ceiling is only +0.05456%; its concrete packing invoice is 1.21467% below selected κ. Both are exact interval cost results. **No improved κ, admitted global supplier, or optimality claim is made.** The selected frontier and frozen predecessor sources remain unchanged.

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12 replay with `-I -O -B`, including source pins, scalar identities, native phases, endpoint adapters, all 4096 private-path Gaussian columns per complete word, and rejecting controls.
- Independent Python 3.14 replay from a source-only export containing the package and its 13 declared inputs; the export remains unchanged.
- `git diff --check`.

The owner certificate is conditional on inherited schedule windows. A new global emitter, backward interface, route/wrapper proof, and recursive precision/reserve admission remain open. The rejected concrete invoice cannot establish a gain even if those obligations are supplied. The README records feasible next questions and distinguishes this construction from the frozen-schedule obstruction in #2082 and other concurrent P104 work.

Predecessor attribution and exact source pins are retained in `README.md` and `SOURCES.json`, including the P104 work, selected scalar word, native compiler/interpreter, T16 owner schedule, and exact cost engine. Prepared for David Arias with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and parallel checking; no human independent review or formal proof assistant is claimed.
